create.title: Create <hl>a tournament</hl>
create.lede: Set the timeline, the game and the bracket format.
create.forbidden: Only referees and administrators can create a tournament.
create.imageFailed: Tournament created, but its image wasn't saved: {error} Add it from the tournament page.

edit.title: Edit <hl>the tournament</hl>
edit.forbidden: Only referees and administrators can edit a tournament.
edit.finished: The tournament is finished: it can no longer be edited.
edit.lockStarted: The tournament is in progress: only referee match scheduling can still be changed.
edit.lockVisible: The tournament has been visible since {date} — the format, the game and the settings can no longer be changed.
edit.planningDisabled: Referee scheduling turned off: matches without a date move into launch.
edit.planningEnabledMoved: Scheduling turned on: {count, plural, =1 {1 match to schedule} other {# matches to schedule}}.

planningErrors.TOURNAMENT_FINISHED: The tournament is finished: this option can no longer be changed.
planningErrors.fallback: Scheduling couldn't be changed. Try again in a moment.

form.name: Tournament name
form.participantTypeHint: In solo, each player registers themselves, without going through a team.

matchFormatValueHint.BO: A team's score can't go past the upper half: 3 in BO5.
matchFormatValueHint.FT: Target to reach to win the match: 3 in FT3.

formatHint.free: Scores are entered without any constraint.
formatHint.invalidBo: A Best of is played over an odd number of maps (BO1, BO3, BO5…).
formatHint.invalidFt: Enter the number of maps to win.

invalidFormat.BO: A Best of must be played over an odd number of maps (BO1, BO3, BO5…).
invalidFormat.other: Invalid number of maps for the match format.

notation.race: first to {wins, plural, one {# map won} other {# maps won}}, {maps} at most.
notation.raceWithDraw: first to {wins, plural, one {# map won} other {# maps won}}, {maps} at most. The match can end without a winner (drawn map).

form.maxMapsHint: Maximum sum of both scores. A drawn map counts for neither side and so doesn't eat into this cap. Lowering it below {max} makes a draw possible.
form.registrationIntro: Checked each time a player registers. Ghost teams registered by the staff aren't subject to them, and entrants already registered are never rechecked.
form.conditionsOpen: As it stands, this tournament is open to everyone: no requirement will be shown.

conditions.minPlayers: {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} minimum
conditions.blizzardAny: at least one linked Blizzard account

discordHint.TEAM: A verified Discord tag is one the player has proven is theirs: it's the only way for the organizers to reach the team during the tournament.
discordHint.SOLO: A verified Discord tag is one the player has proven is theirs: it's the only way for the organizers to reach the player during the tournament.

blizzardHint.TEAM: A Battle.net account linked from “My profile” vouches for each player's BattleTag: a tag that's simply typed in proves nothing.
blizzardHint.SOLO: A Battle.net account linked from “My profile” vouches for the player's BattleTag: a tag that's simply typed in proves nothing.

form.blizzardMarvel: Not relevant for a Marvel Rivals tournament: better leave “No player”.
form.minPlayersHint: Active roster members, coach and manager included. {min} = no requirement.

referee.label: Matches scheduled by the referees
referee.description: Each match waits for a referee or an admin to set its date and time (“To schedule”), then shows “Waiting to start” until that time, when it moves to launch.
referee.finished: The tournament is finished: this option can no longer be changed.
referee.create: Can be changed later, until the tournament closes — even while it's in progress.
referee.edit: Can be changed until the tournament closes — even while it's in progress.
referee.warning: On saving, matches with no date that haven't launched yet leave the launch — their “Ready” calls are cleared — and wait for a referee to set their time. Matches already launched carry on.

settings.endurancePointsHint: Each team's starting points. At 0, it's eliminated.
settings.endurancePlayoffHint: The endurance stage stops at this headcount. At 8, the bracket follows the rulebook table (8v4, 6v2, 1v5, 3v7) with a third-place match.
settings.enduranceMaxRoundsHint: 0 = no limit: the stage runs until the headcount above. Otherwise it stops at this round and the top of the standings qualify; those who can no longer catch up go out before the end.
settings.drawsUnavailable: Unavailable with free score entry: a match format is needed to bound the match.
settings.drawsHint: A drawn map can end the match before the target: the match then closes at 2-2, or at 2-1 if only one map was shared. Since the endurance pool counts map by map, it takes this in without any extra rule. The final bracket always requires a winner. Ticking this box also opens the “Maximum deciding maps” setting, above.
settings.playoffFormatHint: The final bracket never accepts a draw, whatever this setting: it needs to know who plays the next round. Setting it here lets you play a real FT3 in the playoffs when qualifying allows draws.
settings.survivalFirstCutHint: Lets the standings take shape before the first elimination.
settings.survivalRoundsHint: Pace applied after the first cut.
settings.survivalExplain: All teams face each other in pairs according to their standing. At each cut, the bottom two teams are eliminated, until the champion. If the number of entrants is odd, a play-in between the bottom two opens the tournament — no walkover is handed out.

swissRecommended.TEAM: Recommended for {count} teams: {rounds, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}}.
swissRecommended.SOLO: Recommended for {count} players: {rounds, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}}.

settings.swissByeHint: A walkover is worth as much as a win.
settings.swissExplain: No elimination: every team plays all {rounds} rounds. Each round, you face a team with a points total close to yours, never replaying the same opponent while that's possible. On equal points, the tiebreak is Buchholz (the sum of the points of the opponents faced).
settings.thirdPlaceHint: Adds a match to decide 3rd place between the two semifinal losers.

phases.modeHint: A fixed number skips the stage if fewer teams show up; a percentage adapts to the actual number of entrants.
phases.name: Stage name (optional)
